evaluations.rationale: Scores use common-horizon normalized research-work units. The fixed-pair certificate receives the largest local score because withholding it removes the only continuously certified frontier improvement. The premise interface, finite-grid foundation, and continuum bridge each require substantial reconstruction, but their dependent siblings' independent proof content is retained. Residual covers uncertainty about substitution among these overlapping foundations and the still-unproved unrelaxed continuum optimization.

children.counterfactual: Remove the uniform receiver-curve modulus, compactness/density theorem, 30-row stability bounds, and audit tool. Retain the accepted 30-row interface, finite-grid reduction, fixed-pair certificate, and all information independently present in those contributions. A competent solver may rederive only the missing continuum bridge or pursue another regularity argument.

directEffects.rationale: Without the contribution, the alphabet-independent modulus, compact generalized curve space, quantitative finite-support approximation, and rowwise stability calculation would need to be reconstructed. Its exclusions prevent credit for unrelaxed value convergence or a numerical converse not actually proved.

obviatedEffects.rationale: The bridge replaces part of the previously ledgered open-ended search for a rigorous finite-grid-to-continuum connection with a reusable, explicitly scoped regularity framework. Remaining work persists because active rate-free constraints block an unrelaxed convergence theorem.

directEffects.rationale: The contribution supplies the only accepted continuous certificate proving the improved upper endpoint 0.369296945969202842443. Replacing it requires receiver selection, dual discovery, exact row reduction, and full-domain interval verification rather than merely rerunning a finite grid.

directEffects.rationale: A competent solver would need to rebuild the exact sampled-curve reduction, solve the Q0 problem, and recover the coercive midpoint bounds. Credit is limited to the finite-grid scope and excludes continuum cardinality, reflected optimality, and a capacity improvement.

No credit is assigned for authenticating the external theorem, which remains an explicit premise.

evaluations.rationale: The sole child establishes both the exact code-induced structure and a useful negative result closing a specified entropy/copy route. The residual reflects uncertainty about how much of the composite result a solver would independently rediscover while pursuing channel-specific posterior constraints.

Retain all auxiliary-receiver and Marton information independently available at the horizon. The solver may pursue another direct-code converse or independently test entropy/copy refinements.

directEffects.rationale: The contribution avoids reconstructing a dependency-complete finite-block derivation and an exact finite entropic witness. Its no-go component is useful bad news: it saves work on the specified entropy/copy refinement route despite producing no capacity-frontier improvement.

The earlier two-symbol result is almost wholly substituted at the common horizon by the stronger independent full-support theorem. The finite foundation and padding tests remain useful but more limited. Residual covers overlap among pruning mechanisms and uncertainty about how strongly necessary conditions reduce an optimal unrestricted search.

evaluations.rationale: Root scores measure each program's immediate effect on its own canonical route, not the sum of descendant scores. The auxiliary-receiver program has the strongest direct frontier effect; the Marton and code-induced programs provide substantial structural pruning; the relaxed-UV program closes a narrower non-frontier route. Residual preserves uncertainty from unresolved capacity, route substitution, and work not confidently attributable to these four programs.

directEffects.rationale: The program supplies a complete audited interface and the only accepted continuous certificate improving the governed upper endpoint. Replacing that state requires substantially more than a numerical minimization, while the program still falls short of exact capacity.

obviatedEffects.rationale: The certified fixed-pair route and supporting foundations reduce open-ended effort to locate and validate a usable converse below the published benchmark.

It neither finds a gain nor proves unrestricted additivity, so its root value is substantial structural progress rather than endpoint movement.

A competent solver may reexamine whether blocking or correlated super-symbol priors improve these scalar UV relaxations.
